existing_limitations: The bundled ImageMagick cannot load font files from a non-ASCII installation path in either the original OTF package or the shared-TTC package; both returned exit code 1 in the separate relocation probe.
release_regression.external_media_isolation: PATH contains Windows and .NET only; upgraded GUI profiles deliberately name nonexistent FFmpeg and FFprobe executables.

limits: SOXR is used only for diagnostic resampled sample counts, not MLP preparation. Counts match; two fixture raw-PCM probes differ by at most one 24-bit LSB across libsoxr builds. MLP preparation uses SWR and passed exact PCM and whole-file MLP tests.
Full ISO lossless verification retains the existing first-track sampling policy; six authored MLP files were separately compared byte-for-byte.
The authoring fixture disables the existing single-page index-menu issue (MENU_INDEX_ARROW_MISSING) and uses short native tool paths, as in the baseline.
Metaflac remains an external dependency for the optional ALAC-to-FLAC artwork normalization feature. Other authoring tools remain external processes.
Explicit external FFmpeg paths remain available to developer CLI and reference tests; GUI imports always use bundled media.
